from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

path = Path("chart.py")
script = path.read_text()
script = script.replace("legend=False,", "legend=True,")
script = script.replace('data=df[df["Region"] != "Mekong Delta"],', 'data=df,')
script = script.replace('plt.ylabel("Improvement Rate (%)", fontsize=12)',
                        'plt.ylabel("Impact Score (%)", fontsize=12)')
path.write_text(script)
exec(compile(script, "chart.py", "exec"))

table = pd.read_csv("table.csv")
print("Table:\n", table.to_string(index=False))
print("Data matches table:", df.equals(table))
ax = plt.gca()
print("Axis labels:", ax.get_xlabel(), "|", ax.get_ylabel())
print("Legend:", [t.get_text() for t in ax.get_legend().get_texts()])
print("Plotted points:", len(ax.collections[0].get_offsets()))
print("Region counts:", df["Region"].value_counts().to_dict())
print("Title:", ax.get_title())
